summary: Orders API returns 500 under load: QueuePool limit reached
symptoms: During the Black Friday peak the orders API started failing with sqlalchemy.exc.TimeoutError: QueuePool limit of size 5 overflow 10 reached. p95 latency went from 180 ms to 30 s.
root_cause: When the payment gateway timed out, PaymentGatewayUnavailableError was raised before session.close(), so each failed checkout leaked one connection until the pool was exhausted.
resolution: Replaced manual session handling with the get_db_session() context manager (db_session snippet), moved the payment call outside the transaction, and added an alert on the db_pool_checked_out metric. Deployed in release 2026.11.3.

summary: Customer sync job hangs forever when CRM is slow
symptoms: The nightly customer sync job never finished and there were no errors in the logs. A thread dump showed workers blocked on socket.recv inside requests.
root_cause: requests.get() was called without a timeout. The CRM accepted the connection but stopped responding, so the call blocked indefinitely.
resolution: Added timeout=(3.05, 10) to every call, wrapped the client with retry_with_backoff (max 3 attempts), and reused a single requests.Session. Added a lint rule that flags requests calls without timeout.

summary: Invoices service fails to start after credential rotation
symptoms: After the 90-day rotation every new pod crashed with 'password authentication failed for user invoices'.
root_cause: The database password had been copied into a ConfigMap months ago instead of being read from Vault, so the rotated password never reached the service.
resolution: Removed the password from the ConfigMap, injected it from Vault as DB_PASSWORD and restarted the deployment with kubectl rollout restart. Added a CI check that rejects secrets in Kubernetes manifests.

summary: Duplicate payments when mobile app retries checkout
symptoms: Some customers were charged twice. Logs showed two POST /api/v1/payments requests a few seconds apart with the same cart.
root_cause: The mobile client retried POST /payments on a read timeout, and the endpoint was not idempotent.
resolution: Implemented the Idempotency-Key header on POST /payments (stored for 24 hours) as required by the REST API guidelines, and changed the client to send the same key on retries.

summary: Search endpoint p95 latency above SLO after catalog import
symptoms: GET /api/v1/products?category=... p95 went from 120 ms to 2.4 s after importing 3 million products; some requests hit the 5 s statement timeout.
root_cause: Sequential scan on products.category_id (no index) plus an N+1 query loading product images in a loop.
resolution: Created the index with CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_products_category ON products(category_id) and used selectinload for images. p95 back to 95 ms.
